questions.subject: science
questions.question: Nowadays, sometimes there is low rainfall and sometimes heavy rainfall, which has affected agricultural production. What may be the reason for this?
questions.explanation: Climate change can cause very low or very heavy rainfall. This can badly affect farming.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the reason for the increase in the volume of sea level?
questions.explanation: Global warming melts ice and warms ocean water. So sea level increases.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which of the following groups is a group of endangered animals?
options: Swamp deer, Asiatic wild elephant, striped hyena
Asiatic wild elephant, striped hyena, jackal
questions.explanation: These animals are endangered animals. Their number is low, so they need protection.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: In which group of plants does Tulsi belong?
questions.explanation: Tulsi is used as medicine. So it is a medicinal plant.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: The union of a caterpillar with a specific fungus forms Yarsagumba. In this, what is the relation between the caterpillar and fungus?
questions.explanation: The fungus lives on the caterpillar and harms it. So this relation is parasitic.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: In chickenpox, neem powder paste is applied to affected parts and neem leaves are spread on the bed. What property of neem helps this?
questions.explanation: Neem can kill or control harmful germs. So its anti-microbial property is useful.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which part of Bojo is used for medicinal purposes?
questions.explanation: Rhizome is the underground stem of Bojo. This part is used as medicine.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Rama has been coughing for a long time. Which medicinal plant preparation helps to get relief from cough?
questions.explanation: Tulsi water helps in cough, cold and throat problems. So boiled tulsi water gives relief.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which reason best explains the natural disaster shown in the chapter question picture?
questions.explanation: Climate change can cause serious natural disasters. It changes rainfall, temperature and weather.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is climate?
options: Sudden change in one day weather
Average weather pattern for a long time
questions.explanation: Climate means the average weather of a place for a long time. It is not only one day's weather.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is climate change?
options: Daily change from morning to evening
Change in climate over a long period due to unstable nature and human activities
Only the change in wind direction
questions.explanation: Climate change means long-term change in climate. It can happen due to nature and human activities.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is a natural cause of climate change mentioned in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Solar activities are a natural cause of climate change. They can change the heat received by Earth.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which gas group forms a thick layer and traps solar heat according to the chapter?
questions.explanation: Greenhouse gases trap heat around Earth. This makes Earth's temperature rise.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which human activity is given as a cause of climate change?
questions.explanation: Deforestation means cutting forests. It increases carbon dioxide and reduces carbon storage.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is an effect of climate change?
questions.explanation: Climate change can cause droughts and floods. These are harmful effects on people and nature.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What should be reduced to control climate change?
questions.explanation: Carbon emission increases greenhouse gases. Reducing it helps control climate change.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why should green plants be conserved in relation to climate change?
options: They store carbon while making food
questions.explanation: Green plants use carbon dioxide to make food. So they help store carbon and reduce warming.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What are rare organisms?
options: Organisms whose number is very low or decreasing
questions.explanation: Rare organisms have very low or decreasing numbers. They may become extinct if not protected.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which is a conservation measure for rare wildlife?
questions.explanation: Poaching means illegal killing or hunting. Stopping poaching helps save rare wildlife.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which plant is called Ghiu Kumari in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Aloe vera is also called Ghiu Kumari. It is a useful medicinal plant.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is Nepal at high risk of climate change although its greenhouse gas emission is negligible?
options: Because adverse effects can occur even with low national emission
Because greenhouse gases do not move
Because climate change affects only developed nations
questions.explanation: Nepal emits little greenhouse gas but can still suffer effects. Climate change affects many places, not only big polluters.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: How does volcanic eruption contribute to climate change?
options: It removes all gases from the air
It permanently cools every place equally
It sends carbon dioxide and aerosols into the atmosphere
questions.explanation: Volcanoes release carbon dioxide and aerosols. These can affect temperature and climate.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the role of industrialization in climate change?
options: Factories release gases from burning fossil fuels
questions.explanation: Factories burn fossil fuels and release gases. These gases help increase climate change.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which effect of climate change directly threatens biodiversity?
options: Changes in life processes of organisms and habitat conditions
questions.explanation: Climate change changes habitats and life processes. This can reduce biodiversity.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which statement about sea level rise matches the chapter?
options: Sea level rises only because forests grow
Sea level falls when glaciers melt
Warming melts ice and expands ocean water
Sea level is unrelated to temperature
questions.explanation: Warming melts ice and expands ocean water. Both increase sea level.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the importance of public awareness in climate change control?
options: It helps people adopt environment-friendly habits
It replaces natural habitat with roads
It stops the need for conservation
questions.explanation: Public awareness teaches people good habits. This helps reduce pollution and climate change.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why are endangered plants and animals conserved in their natural habitat?
options: Their food, shelter and breeding conditions remain available
questions.explanation: Natural habitat gives food, shelter and breeding place. So endangered organisms are safer there.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which set contains only medicinal plants mentioned in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Tulsi, Neem and Aloe vera are medicinal plants. They are used for health problems.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is Tulsi considered important in rural health practices?
options: It is used for cold, throat pain and infection
It is used only to build houses
It is used only as animal feed
questions.explanation: Tulsi is used for cold, throat pain and infection. So it is important in rural health care.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why can excessive consumption of neem juice be harmful?
options: It may lead to extremely low blood pressure
questions.explanation: Too much neem juice can lower blood pressure too much. So it should not be used excessively.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which characteristic of Gurjo is emphasized in the chapter?
options: It is only used as a fuel wood
It boosts immunity and has antioxidant properties
It grows only inside the sea
questions.explanation: Gurjo helps boost immunity. It also has antioxidant properties.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is one medicinal use of Asiatic pennywort (Ghod tapre)?
options: Enhancing mental capacity and memory power
questions.explanation: Ghod tapre helps memory and mental capacity. So it is used as a medicinal plant.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which chemical gives turmeric its medicinal property and yellow colour?
questions.explanation: Curcumin is found in turmeric. It gives turmeric yellow colour and medicinal value.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is Malabar nut (Asuro) useful in respiratory ailments?
options: It contains chemicals such as vasicine and helps clear mucus
It is only used as a dye
questions.explanation: Asuro has useful chemicals like vasicine. It helps remove mucus in breathing problems.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which habitat is related to Bojo in the chapter?
options: Swampy land and banks of ponds or ditches
questions.explanation: Bojo grows in swampy places and near ponds. That habitat is suitable for it.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the upper part of Yarsagumba according to the chapter?
questions.explanation: Yarsagumba has an upper fungal part. The lower part is the caterpillar part.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is Yarsagumba regarded as rare?
options: Its collection, use, sale and export are prohibited by the government
It is a common garden plant
questions.explanation: Yarsagumba is rare and strictly controlled. Its collection and sale are prohibited.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: What is the gel of Aloe vera used for?
options: Skin problems, sunburn and faster healing of burns
questions.explanation: Aloe vera gel helps skin problems and burns. It gives relief from sunburn and cracked skin.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which measure is an example of ex-situ conservation?
options: Managing rare wildlife outside its natural habitat when needed
questions.explanation: Ex-situ conservation means conserving outside natural habitat. It is used when natural habitat conservation is not enough.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why can medicinal plant cultivation support the economy?
options: Medicinal herbs must never be studied
Medicinal herbs can be processed and used commercially
questions.explanation: Medicinal plants can be processed and sold. This can support local economy.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A community cuts forest to build roads and then experiences more temperature rise and habitat loss. Which combined chapter concept explains this?
options: Deforestation increases carbon dioxide and destroys natural habitat
Habitat loss has no effect on rare animals
questions.explanation: Deforestation increases carbon dioxide and destroys habitats. So it causes warming and loss of wildlife homes.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A plant is conserved because it provides raw materials for medicine and is becoming rare. Which two chapter ideas are combined?
options: Medicinal use and conservation of rare plants
questions.explanation: Some rare plants are useful for medicine. So medicinal value and conservation are both important.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: If a medicine seller promotes unlimited use of Gurjo, what source-based caution should be given?
options: Optimum use is safe but excessive use may reduce blood sugar level
Gurjo should be used only as fuel
Gurjo has no effect on immunity
questions.explanation: Gurjo is useful in proper amount. Too much Gurjo may lower blood sugar.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is Yarsagumba not a normal green plant?
options: It is a fungus with no root, stem, leaf, flower and fruit
questions.explanation: Yarsagumba is a fungus, not a green plant. It has no root, stem, leaf, flower or fruit.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which chain correctly shows climate-change control according to the chapter?
options: Burn fuels -> cut forests -> increase carbon storage
Poach animals -> reduce awareness -> conserve habitat
Reduce carbon emission -> conserve plants -> increase carbon storage
Increase pollution -> reduce greenhouse gases -> cool Earth
questions.explanation: Reducing carbon emission lowers greenhouse gases. Conserving plants helps store more carbon.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why should laws and public awareness be used together in wildlife conservation?
options: Laws restrict harmful acts while awareness changes behaviour
Laws increase poaching and awareness destroys habitat
questions.explanation: Laws stop harmful activities like poaching. Awareness changes people's behaviour.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: A farmer wants a plant that is aromatic, grows near ponds and is used for throat disorders. Which plant fits the chapter?
questions.explanation: Bojo is aromatic and grows near ponds. It is also used for throat disorders.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which option best explains why the same climate change event can affect both humans and biodiversity?
options: It changes water, weather, habitats and health conditions
It only changes one plant species
It has no effect on food or shelter
questions.explanation: Climate change affects water, weather, habitats and health. So it can harm both humans and biodiversity.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Why is preserving traditional knowledge important for medicinal plants?
options: Correct use and sustainable management need local knowledge and research
questions.explanation: Traditional knowledge teaches correct use of medicinal plants. It also helps use them sustainably.

questions.subject: science
questions.question: Which conclusion is best if a protected animal population decreases because of hunting and habitat destruction?
options: Both anti-poaching action and habitat conservation are needed
questions.explanation: Hunting reduces protected animals and habitat loss makes survival harder. So both poaching control and habitat conservation are needed.
